label: ISO 14001:2015 — Etcher wording
wording: Etcher's own paraphrase of each requirement, not ISO text (plan D8). Check the licensed standard for the authoritative text.
scopeNote: Base 2015 edition as written in the source workbook. Does NOT include the 2024 climate-change amendment (Amd 1:2024) — the workbook predates it (plan A67).
sourceFilename: Etcher ISO gap analysis workbook V2.0 (library columns only)

sections.title: Actions to address risks and opportunities

items.clauseName: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
items.requirement: Determine WHO the interested parties are relevant to the EMS

imported.evidenceExamples:
Who are relevant interested parties? People or groups of people (organizations) that can affect the EMS or be affected by the EMS. These could be identified with the process followed for 4.1 above:
PEST Analysis
SWOT Analysis

items.requirement:
Have processes in place to prepare for and respond to emergencies:
- Plan how to mitigate adverse environmental impacts resulting from potential emergencies
- Respond to emergencies
- Act to prevent or mitigate their consequences
- Test responses (drills)
- Periodically review and update plans
- maintain documented information

imported.evidenceExamples:
Potential emergencies should have been identified in addressing clause 6.1
Review of emergency response plans should particularly take place after an emergency has occurred - performance can then be evaluated and plans improved as necessary
Emergency drill checklist and form
Emergency response plans and procedures
